entries.39e5d7c0e7f5392e: This business enables customers of partner financial institutions and others to make withdrawals, deposits and balance inquiries at the company's ATMs, and it is the company's core business. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.3ca86664891f11f3: This business provides ordinary deposits, time deposits, loan services, overseas remittance services and debit services, among others, to customers holding accounts with the company. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.73327f63447ce54c: Seven Bank is a bank centered on a network of ATMs installed in stores such as Seven-Eleven, and also operates account services, credit cards and electronic money, and an overseas ATM business.
entries.a7092f303873d1d8: This business is conducted by Seven Card Service Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, which operates non-bank businesses, centered on credit card and electronic money businesses, among others. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, ordinary income from external customers was ¥30,577 million.
entries.b2e36c11482429c5: In 4 countries, namely the United States, Indonesia, the Philippines and Malaysia, local consolidated subsidiaries each provide ATM services. In the United States, ATMs are installed at Seven-Eleven stores and other stores. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, ordinary income from external customers was ¥43,602 million.
entries.c348c7244a0758d0: Credit Card and Electronic Money Business
entries.fef24af73919ef3d: This business provides ATM services through an ATM network that operates, in principle, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, with ATMs installed at Seven-Eleven stores and other stores, airports, train stations and financial institution branches, in partnership with many domestic financial institutions. For customers holding accounts, it also provides account services such as ordinary deposits, time deposits, loan services, overseas remittance services and debit services. As of the end of March 2026, 28,536 ATMs were installed, and there were 696 partner financial institutions and others. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, ordinary income from external customers was ¥145,846 million.
